metadata.title: Amazing HIMACHAL Food Series
metadata.description:
► Subscribe to Delhi Food Walks: https://www.youtube.com/user/Delhifoodwalks

► More Street Food in Himachal:  
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9J8V0mH1Dic&list=PLDs8Vu-e-HxJHM2I_5c-1B82oWH8OyMt7

The culinary landscape of Himachal Pradesh is as beautiful and pristine as its natural beauty. 

On our visit to this enchanting land, we were privileged to gather a memorable experience exploring the unique local cuisine, meeting lovely locals and celebrating the vibrant culture.

Come and join us in this amazing gastronomic expedition than begins on our YouTube channel tomorrow onwards. 

Till then keep walking, keep exploring.

#HimachalFoodTour #Himachal

About the host - Anubhav Sapra:

Anubhav Sapra is an avid foodie! He is a Founder but proudly calls himself a Foodie-in-chief at Delhi Food Walks. He is also a street-food and Indian regional cuisine connoisseur and loves to write about street-food. To know more, visit www.anubhavsapra.com 

Please subscribe to our YouTube channel to keep our Indian street food explorations video in your feed! 

Thank you for watching! 

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/delhifoodwalks
